column7: R1: every name a program introduces is declared by the lowerer before the emitter sees a read -- a sigilless `my \a`, a `constant`, a `::T` capture used as a type or a value, a pod block, a compile-time `$?` variable, an rhs shape with no native arm, an excised node -- and the emitter's refusal (scrip.c:638, `variable X is read but never assigned`, 211 of Roast's 301 mode-3 REJECTs over 135 names) becomes a lowering error that names the file's line or a lowering; the refusal has no reader among Roast's files

R2: pod is data, not a variable: the parser keeps every pod block as a tree node (`=begin`/`=end`, `=for`, `=head`, `=item`, `=code`, `=table`, `=defn`, formatting codes, `#|`/`#=` declarator comments) and the lowerer builds `$=pod` as an array of the prelude classes Pod::Block::Named, ::Para, ::Code, ::Table, ::Comment, ::Declarator, Pod::Heading, Pod::Item, Pod::Defn, Pod::FormattingCode with `.contents`, `.name`, `.config`, `.level`, and `.WHY` on a declared symbol (the 19 `=pod` refusals, 18 of S26)
column8: src/parsers/raku/rk_syntax.c; rk_tree.c; src/lower/lower_raku.c; the Raku prelude (the Pod classes)

column7: R3: a variable's slot holds its value (today); a CONTAINER exists where the program asks for one: `:=` between lexicals is a compile-time alias of the slot, a run-time binding (an element, a hash value, a conditional bind) stores a REF descriptor to a heap Scalar cell dereferenced at use, an `is rw` parameter receives the caller's slot address for the call's lifetime (THE LIFETIME RULE), `VAR(x)` and `.VAR` answer a Scalar object over the slot or the cell (`.^name` Scalar, `.name`, `.of`, and `.dynamic`, True only for a variable declared with the `*` twigil or the `is dynamic` trait and False for every other variable and for an element's container; the cto 2026-11-11 on the cfo's measurement: S02-names is_dynamic, dynamic-scope and name use `.VAR.dynamic` 31 times), and on an `@` or `%` variable `.VAR` answers the Array or Hash itself (`.name` with its sigil, `@a`; `.^name` Array or Hash), a bound literal is immutable and an assignment to it dies X::Assignment::RO; `VAR(`, `WHAT(`, `HOW(`, `WHO(`, `WHICH(`, `WHERE(` exist as the function forms of the meta calls
column8: src/lower/lower_raku.c (binding, is rw, the meta calls); src/runtime/by_name_dispatch.c (the Scalar object); the frame maps (a REF slot kind)

column7: R4: a role is a TEMPLATE and composition is instantiation: `does R` copies the role's hoisted body (its `my` lexicals, methods, attributes, required-method list) into the composing class once per class, so each class owns its lexicals (Rakudo 1,2,1); a parametric role instantiates once per (class, argument tuple) (Cnt2[Int] in C and E are two copies: 1,2,1,1); a run-time mixin (`$v but R`, `$v does R`) composes an anonymous class per mixin site over the value's type, the value retagged to it, its own copy of R's body; conflict and required-method errors are the composing class's at lowering
column8: src/lower/lower_raku.c (rk_class_body, rk_role_specialized, class_compose_role); src/runtime/by_name_dispatch.c (the mixin class)

column7: R5: a Seq is a generator box road (ARCH-RAKU-BOXES step 2, landed for gather and `...`) completed: `.iterator`/`pull-one`/`push-exactly` as the generator's beta driven by a consumer box, `is-lazy` a fact of the Seq (an infinite range or a `lazy` mark is lazy, a finite gather is not), a Seq that ESCAPES its expression (assigned to a scalar, returned, stored) becomes a co-expression with its own stack (CEO-1619's escape boundary, Icon's `create`) resumed by `pull-one`, lazy `map`/`grep`/`first`/`head`/`tail` chains as generator boxes over the source generator with no array staging
column8: src/lower/lower_raku.c (rk_lower_iter_meth, the gather road); src/templates/bb (the generator boxes); src/runtime/rt/rt_coexpr.c (the escaped Seq)

column7: R6 (ARCH-RAKU-BOXES step 3): a regex is a pattern graph lowered at compile time into the four-port boxes of its kinds -- literal, class, alternation with longest-token ordering, quantifier with backtracking, capture (positional and named, `$/` built as a Match tree), anchor, lookaround, named rule call with recursion, `:ratchet` for token and rule, sigspace, `<~~>`, closures -- the grammar's rules are procedures whose α enters the pattern at the cursor and whose γ returns the Match; actions run at a rule's γ; `s///`, `.subst`, `m:g`, `.match` are drivers over the same boxes; rx.c's parser and interpreter and grammar_parse_core have no caller
column8: src/parsers/raku/rk_regex.c (the regex tree); src/lower/lower_raku.c (the pattern graph); src/templates/bb (the pattern boxes shared with SNOBOL4); src/runtime/rx.c (deleted)

column7: R7: `die` unwinds by THE FRAME WALK (ARCH-GC section 13: return PC, site table, link word) to the nearest frame whose shape carries a CATCH or CONTROL block, running each left frame's LEAVE/UNDO phasers on the way, restoring rsp and rbp to that frame and entering the handler's α with `$!` bound; a `when` in CATCH that matches handles, an unmatched exception rethrows; `.resume` returns to the throw site for a resumable exception (warn, CX::Warn); `fail` returns a Failure (a value carrying the exception, false and undefined until handled, thrown on use under `use fatal` or when sunk); `return`, `last`, `next`, `redo` across block boundaries and labels are control exceptions on the same walk; ENTER/LEAVE/KEEP/UNDO/FIRST/NEXT/LAST/PRE/POST are the frame shape's blocks; typed exceptions X::AdHoc, X::Multi::NoMatch, X::TypeCheck::Binding, X::Assignment::RO are prelude classes with Rakudo's messages
column8: src/lower/lower_raku.c (TT_TRY, TT_CATCH, phasers, control); src/planner/frame_layout.c (the handler and phaser facts of a shape); src/runtime/core (the walk); the prelude (X:: classes)

column7: R8 (ARCH-RAKU-BOXES step 4): a multi's candidates are sorted at lowering by type narrowness and bound at the call by a generated dispatcher (arity, type, `where`, named, optional, slurpy, coercion `Int()`), `proto` with `{*}` wrapping the chosen candidate, X::Multi::NoMatch and X::TypeCheck::Binding on failure; a method call on a receiver of known type resolves at lowering, an unknown receiver dispatches through a per-type table (name to address) the lowerer emits, `.can`, `.^name`, `.^methods` read the same table; rt_str_method's 101 strcmps and rk_list_more_methods' name chains have no caller
column8: src/lower/lower_raku.c (the dispatcher, the method tables); src/runtime/by_name_dispatch.c (rt_str_method, rt_multi_meth_dispatch, invoke_method_proc deleted)

column7: R9 (ARCH-RAKU-BOXES step 5): `~~` lowers by the right operand's kind at compile time where known (type, regex, code, range, junction, literal, list) and through a kind switch box otherwise; `given`/`when` are the same; a junction at a relop or a sub argument autothreads as the box's own alternation over the eigenstates and collapses at a boolean context (`so`), with junction_collapse in C retired; the metaoperators `[+]`, `>>.`, `Z`, `X`, `R`, `!`, `=` and the hyper forms lower to loops over boxes
column8: src/lower/lower_raku.c (smartmatch, junctions, metaops); src/runtime/by_name_dispatch.c (__rk_smartmatch, __rk_jct_* and junction_collapse deleted)

column7: R10: Test is a Raku module compiled by SCRIP as a prelude module -- Rakudo's lib/Test.rakumod (953 lines: plan, ok, nok, is, isnt, is-deeply, is-approx, cmp-ok, isa-ok, can-ok, does-ok, like, unlike, throws-like, dies-ok, lives-ok, eval-dies-ok, eval-lives-ok, subtest, todo, skip, skip-rest, pass, flunk, diag, bail-out, use-ok, done-testing) -- so every roast file's test functions are SCRIP's own compiled code and the 590 files using throws-like or dies-ok read their real first failure; the C arms __rk_test_* are deleted

column7: R11: EVAL already compiles at run time through runtime_eval with the lexical scope visible (rr11_eval EQUAL today) and stays so; Promise, Supply, Channel, `start`, `await`, `react`/`whenever`, Lock and the scheduler run on the thread runtime of ARCH-PROLOG-THREADS (CEO-1764: the cells land as one runtime-stage struct, none holding a stack; a co-expression's stack per thread) -- a `start` block is a procedure on a new thread whose Promise is kept at its γ and broken at its ω; UNLESS Lon excludes S17 by his word (GOAL-RAKU-100's open question, Phase H), in which case the 99 files leave the denominator as THREADS_EXCLUDED_BY_LON and this step is EVAL alone; the ceo asks Lon before the row is minted
